findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan adjacent to building structures, but no specific clearance dimensions are provided between pad edges and building foundations. Cannot verify compliance with minimum 5-foot clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: transformer pad 5 (southeast, near eastern wood fence)
findings.comment: Wood fence is shown along the eastern property boundary, and transformer pad 5 is located in the eastern portion of the site. However, no specific clearance dimensions or access door orientation is shown on any plan. Cannot verify compliance with required 5-foot clearance to sides with operators/controls or 3-foot clearance to other sides.

No clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are dimensioned on any plans. No Austin Energy Design written approval documents are included in the site plan set. Cannot verify whether reduced clearance conditions are met or approved.

No building elevation sheets are provided showing window, door, or ventilating duct locations relative to transformer pad locations. Cannot verify minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance from windows/doors/ducts when within 5-foot lateral separation.

applicableAreas: transformer pad 1 (northwest, adjacent to 5-foot concrete sidewalk)
findings.comment: A 5-foot concrete sidewalk is shown along the western property boundary adjacent to transformer pad 1. No specific dimension is provided showing the distance from the pad edge to the sidewalk back of curb. Cannot verify minimum 2-foot clearance requirement.

No access door orientations are indicated on the electrical plan, and no clearance dimensions are provided from transformer pads to open areas or adjacent buildings. Cannot verify minimum 10-foot clearance to hot-stick use area.

Fire hydrants are shown on the site plan (one private hydrant and public access), including one near transformer pad 5. No specific clearance dimensions are provided between fire hydrant locations and transformer pad edges. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: areas adjacent to transformer pads with tree symbols shown
findings.comment: Tree symbols are scattered throughout the landscape plan, and a 'Tree Well' notation appears near transformer pad 1 on the site plan. However, no specific distances between trees and transformer pads are dimensioned, and no cross-reference is provided between landscape plan tree species list and transformer pad locations. Cannot verify that trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F.

Landscape elements are shown on the landscape plan, including notation of 'Tree Well' near transformer pad 1. However, no specific distances from shrubs/vegetation to transformer pads are dimensioned, and no access door orientation is indicated on plans. Cannot verify minimum 10-foot clearance from access door side or 5-foot clearance from other sides.

Trees are shown on the landscape plan but no root barrier detail drawings or locations are provided on any sheets. Cannot verify whether trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment have required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment).

Bicycle parking is noted on the site plan (41 total spaces provided), but specific bike rack locations are not shown on the electrical plan in relation to transformer pads, and no clearance dimensions are provided. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot clearance requirement.

Exterior lighting is required per the site plan notes, but specific light pole locations are not dimensioned or shown on the electrical plan in relation to transformer pads. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: between multiple transformer pads (5 total pads present)
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical design plan, but no clearance dimensions are provided between pad locations. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot clearance between transformer pads.

Water utility lines are shown on the utility tap plan and site plan, but no specific clearance dimensions are provided between water lines and transformer pad locations. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement.

Wastewater easement is noted on site plan, but no specific clearance dimensions are provided between wastewater lines and transformer pad locations. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement.

Storm drain infrastructure with extensive piping is shown throughout the site including in interior drive aisles where transformer pads are located. No specific clearance dimensions are provided between storm lines and transformer pads. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (if gas service present)
findings.comment: No gas utility plan, gas infrastructure, or gas line pressure specifications are shown in the site plan package. Cannot determine whether gas service is present or verify clearance requirements (24 inches minimum for gas pipelines less than 60 psi, 36 inches minimum for high-pressure gas 60 psi and over).

Multiple utilities are shown on various plans (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric), but no specific horizontal and vertical clearance dimensions are provided from transformer pads. Cannot verify minimum 12-inch clearance requirement.

Utility lines are shown on plan view sheets, but no cross-section drawings are provided demonstrating that transformer pads and Austin Energy underground facilities are not located over or under other utility lines. Cannot verify compliance.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (overhead distribution lines present on site)
findings.comment: Overhead electrical distribution lines (OHE) are shown on the site plan, particularly along the southern boundary and other locations. No specific clearance dimensions or cross-section drawings show the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from transformer pad locations. Cannot verify compliance.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (overhead distribution lines present)
findings.comment: Overhead distribution lines are shown on plans but no 15-foot radius clearances from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors (measured from conductors, not pole centerline) are dimensioned on any plan. Cannot verify compliance.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations (overhead distribution lines present on site)
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances from transformer pad locations to overhead distribution lines. Cross-sections are required to verify compliance with minimum sky-to-ground clearances when overhead distribution facilities are present on site.

No transformer equipment specifications identify whether equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. No grading plan with drainage direction arrows around transformer pads is provided. Cannot verify that liquid flow from oil-filled equipment is directed away from buildings as required.

applicableAreas: transformer pad 1 and potentially other pads (utility easements present along western and central portions)
findings.comment: Site plan shows transformer pads located within or immediately adjacent to utility easements (10-foot PUE and sidewalk easement). No Austin Energy Design written approval documents are provided to confirm that placement in these easements is authorized. Cannot verify compliance with prohibited easement restriction.

Transformer easements are not depicted or labeled around any of the five transformer pads shown on the site plan and electrical plan. Transformer easements are required by UCM § 1.10.3 for Austin Energy accessibility and maintenance of equipment.

While transformer pads are shown on private property, no specific routing of electrical lines from transformer to meter is dimensioned on any plan to demonstrate that routing remains 100% on private property without crossing easements or public right-of-way.

No specific dimensions (length and width) are shown for any of the five transformer pads on the electrical plan. No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included in the site plan package for the specified service type. Transformer pad dimensions must match AE Design-approved details per UCM § 1.5.2.6.

applicableAreas: all transformer pads (located adjacent to/within parking areas and drive lanes)
findings.comment: All five transformer pads are shown adjacent to parking stalls and main internal drive lanes (within 4 feet of parking/traffic areas). No bollards or 4-inch diameter galvanized rigid metal posts are shown on any plans around any of the transformer pads. Required bollards per AE Design equipment pad details are missing.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (overhead distribution facilities present)
findings.comment: Overhead distribution facilities are shown on site. No clear demonstration is provided that customer facilities (buildings, parking, structures) will not be installed under or over the overhead distribution lines.
